ruleDefinitions.name: Elevated System Shell Spawned From Uncommon Parent Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a shell program such as the Windows command prompt or PowerShell is launched with system privileges from a uncommon parent location.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "powershell\_ise\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe")) AND ((user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")) AND logon_id = "0x3e7")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\.*")) OR parent_process_path = "None" OR (parent_process_path = "" OR parent_process_path = "\-")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\ManageEngine\\\\ADManager\\ Plus\\\\pgsql\\\\bin\\\\postgres\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\system32\\\\cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c\\ \\.*") AND process_working_directory = RGX(".*\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Temp\\\\asgard2\\-agent\\\\.*")) OR (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\IBM\\\\SpectrumProtect\\\\webserver\\\\scripts\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\IBM\\\\SpectrumProtect\\\\webserver\\\\scripts\\\\.*")))
